pdf_explanation: The corresponding patterns are mirror images of each other.
why: Figure 2 is the mirror image of figure 1: the order of the shapes is flipped from left to right, so the black bar moves to the other end and the pentagon now points left. Do the same flip to figure 3 and you get oval, oval, left-pointing triangle, black oval, oval, which is option 3. Option 4 is tempting because its triangle also points left, but its black oval is at the end, so it is not a true mirror image.
trick: For a mirror image, read the first figure from right to left. Check both the order of the shapes and which way each shape points.
note: The PDF answer C fits the figures: it is the exact left-right mirror image of figure 3.
